item.title: Vijay learnt to rap, Vijaya learnt to sell; Meta did the rest
item.description: Meta For Business' latest campaign, built by creative agency Talented, earns its watch time. And the reason has less to do with its celebrity casting and more to do with something rarer in advertising: restraint. The ad follows Vijaya, who starts an online fashion store, and Vijay Sethupathi, who is learning to rap for a movie role. Their worlds run parallel until they don't. item.title: The nine-year itch: Why Z returned to the kids’ category with a digital-first multiverse
item.description: Children’s media consumption has changed significantly over the past decade. They went from watching cartoons on the TV at an eye-safe distance to consuming content on mobile phones or tablets inches away from their faces. However, the current Indian kids' content market is mostly limited to the high-budget global giants and the algorithmic allure of YouTube. item.title: LinkedIn report maps five skill stacks shaping the job market in 2026
item.description: New data from LinkedIn suggests that many young professionals are finding it difficult to decide which skills to learn for today’s job market, as the pace of technological change makes that choice harder. According to the platform, 38% of Indian job seekers say they feel unprepared for how quickly technology is reshaping the skills required for current roles. item.title: JioStar appoints Pranav Kunkalienkar as associate director- corporate comms
item.description: JioStar has appointed Pranav Kunkalienkar as associate director – corporate communications. item.title: Chandni Shah on why Kinnect will take on only five new clients this year
item.description: Chandni Shah, founder and long-time chief operating officer of Kinnect, has stepped into the role of CEO at the agency as well as at 22feet Tribal Worldwide. item.title: Verve Media bags digital mandate for Proticons
item.description: Proticons, a brand focused on protein-rich and functional nutrition products, has appointed Verve Media as its digital marketing agency. item.title: Goafest 2026 to take place from 20 to 22nd May, 2026
item.description: The Advertising Agencies Association of India (AAAI) and The Advertising Club (TAC) has announced that the 19th edition of Goafest will be held in Goa during May 20 to May 22, 2026. item.title: Chinese Wok introduces Schezwan Fries with new campaign
item.description: Chinese Wok has introduced a new fries range across its outlets, marking the brand’s entry into the French fries category. The range includes Schezwan Fries, Classic Salted Fries, and Cheese Fries. The company positions Schezwan Fries as the lead variant, combining its existing Schezwan flavour profile with the fries format.
